title: Failed landing keeps the work on a pushed coder/stranded-<task8> ref
body:
P2.2: on landing failure, commit the change to coder/stranded-<task8> pushed to origin (in the issue-flow process, outside the guard), so the worktree becomes removable and the work is recoverable by branch. Mention the ref in the issue comment.

From the Paseo worktree gap analysis (docs/worktrees/2026-10-03-paseo-worktree-gap-analysis.md, 61580a0aec).
